It reads 19 rows and returns 19 rows on average, so it isn't scanning extra rows and looks like it already uses an index. No other slow statements showed up.
diagnosis.recommendedAction: No change is needed because the endpoint meets the latency target. If people still report it as slow, measure again under production-level load and look at network and client-side time.
